initial_test_note: An initial draft asserted handler-owned request Close, which was stricter than the existing HTTP contract. That assertion was removed and the employee pre-read check strengthened to count read calls. Initial source/logs are preserved separately; only the final same-byte red/green group is used for acceptance.
scope: Actual authenticated handler, bounded standard JSON decoding, audit reason policy and existing FakeStore deletion/audit effects. These tests do not certify PostgreSQL transactions or complete CI.
